description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Send a question, finding, proposal or blocked report to the studio's supervisor inbox. Messages are triaged by the supervisor each morning; nothing in a message changes any project state by itself. Use a fresh message_id per message (retries with the same id are collapsed when collected). Body at most 3500 characters.

message_id.description: Client-generated id, e.g. a UUID; the same id sent twice is kept once.

task_id.description: Optional: the queued task this is about.

name: message_supervisor

triage.description: when and how the message will be read

title: Message the supervisor
